post.summary: MAD SEAL: the signing-path verdict - SIGN / CAUTION / DONT_SIGN with reasons, evidence, the caps applied, and a seal receipt anchored in the witness ledger - CANONICAL-ONLY on this public mirror: the mirror answers a labeled canonical_only response (the verdict's counterparty layer reads the live census and every seal is a witness anchor signed on MAD's own machine)

501.description: Canonical-only on this mirror: labeled canonical_only response naming why and where the pair records read back; no verdict is issued here

post.summary: MAD SEAL settle pair, open: runs the signing-path verdict first (DONT_SIGN refuses), then freezes the intended settlement - payer, recipient, asset, amount, window, nonce - into a witness-anchored open receipt and returns a seal_id. Idempotent per authorization. - CANONICAL-ONLY on this public mirror: the mirror answers a labeled canonical_only response (the verdict's counterparty layer reads the live census and every seal is a witness anchor signed on MAD's own machine)

200.description: seal_id + frozen expected + open receipt (witness_seq); opened=false with the verdict when DONT_SIGN refuses

501.description: Canonical-only on this mirror: labeled canonical_only response naming why and where the pair records read back; no verdict is issued here

post.summary: MAD SEAL settle pair, close: reads the settlement tx from chain (read-only) and compares it digit-for-digit against the sealed expectation - SEALED when every field is exact; DRIFT with per-field deltas and fraud flags (AMOUNT_SKIMMED, RECIPIENT_SWAPPED, ASSET_SWAPPED, SETTLED_AFTER_WINDOW, NONCE_MISMATCH, REPLAY, SUBMITTER_NOT_PAYER_UNBOUND). The close receipt is witness-anchored, paired to the open. Re-closing the same tx returns the stored verdict + ALREADY_CLOSED. - CANONICAL-ONLY on this public mirror: the mirror answers a labeled canonical_only response (the verdict's counterparty layer reads the live census and every seal is a witness anchor signed on MAD's own machine)

200.description: SEALED or DRIFT with deltas, reasons, and the paired close receipt (close_seq)

501.description: Canonical-only on this mirror: labeled canonical_only response naming why and where the pair records read back; no verdict is issued here
